'''Jook-jook H'broozin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] serving the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] on [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]] during the Order's early years. Joining several other Jedi, H'broozin became a Jedi Renunciate and a [[Legions of Lettow|Legionnaire]] of [[Lettow]], one of the many followers of [[Xendor]] during the [[First Great Schism]].

==Biography==
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]], Jook-jook H'broozin lived on [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]], the home of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during its early years. Ascending to the rank of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]], H'broozin took [[Danzigorro Potts]] as his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] and began training him in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. At this time, H'broozin became enamored by the enigmatic teachings of [[Xendor]],<ref name="JvS" /> who preached that the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] was too restrictive in their teachings and wished to limit understanding of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. When Xendor parted with the Order to found an [[Legionnaire Academy|academy]] on [[Lettow]],<ref name="TEGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> H'broozin abandoned his teachings and his student to learn from Xendor.<ref name="JvS" /> Calling themselves the [[Legions of Lettow]], the Jedi Renunciates grew strong in the Force as they studied the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|Bogan]] through many different Force-traditions.<ref name="TEGTW" />

When the High Council declared war on the Legions of Lettow, H'broozin was joined by fellow Legionnaires [[Blendri]] and [[Cuthallox]] and took up [[Force-imbued sword/Legends|swords]] to protect their rights to study the Force. Meeting the Order in a full-blown conflict that would come to be known as the [[First Great Schism]], the former Jedi Master jumped from world to world to fight off the Jedi. H'broozin encountered Danzigorro Potts on [[Corulag/Legends|Corulag]] and they [[Duel on Corulag|crossed swords]]. When H'broozin's guard was down, Potts ran his former master through with his sword, killing him.<ref name="JvS" />
